gen-vast-shadow-manrope: Manrope reads friendly and bright, with open mouths on its curves and barely any step from capitals to lowercase. Vast Shadow above it brings the vintage showiness.
gen-vast-shadow-noto-serif: Vast Shadow stamps its vintage letters in a single unbroken stroke width, curves included. And Noto Serif below adds a quiet thick-thin rhythm, so shrinking the heading would blunt that shine.
gen-vast-shadow-satoshi: Vintage and loud, with tall, generous letters up top. Satoshi follows with a soaring x-height and an open e, a body that holds its own against Vast Shadow's showiness.
gen-amatic-sc-archivo: Scrappy, hand-lettered charm leads the way here. Amatic SC is best at rustic, quirky flair, while Archivo handles the steady work with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height.
gen-amatic-sc-fs-public-sans: Public Sans sets a hefty, trustworthy lowercase with broad openings in its rounds, a sturdy base for the page. But Amatic SC does the playful talking, its pen-drawn strokes keeping a fixed nib width.
gen-amatic-sc-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy strip of text with letters held open. Amatic SC lets the page loosen up above it, its thin rings of o keeping a constant wall while Supreme carries the weight.
gen-amatic-sc-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and confident, its x-height filling the line and every bend left unobstructed. And the plain sans keeps a steady pressure from start to finish, a calm counterpoint to Amatic SC's hand-squeezed heading.
gen-amatic-sc-manrope: Manrope brings a bright, approachable body, with open gaps on every curve and little step between capitals and lowercase. And its steady line is the pair's best trait, grounding Amatic SC's rustic, quirky heading.
gen-amatic-sc-satoshi: Rustic and quirky, a toothpaste-line heading. Satoshi's soaring x-height and open e carry the text, though a small Amatic SC heading would shrink away beside that sans.
gen-amatic-sc-switzer: Approachable is the word for Switzer, with tidy c tips, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line. Switzer handles the reading, while Amatic SC does what it does best: casual, pen-and-paper charm up top.
